units.title: SG-6.4.4 · A 401 from Approve, Retry or Reject returns to the token gate
Act: Clear action error state in the handleError 401 branch
Act: Reset round, execution and contributions in the 401 branch
Verify: Approve, Retry and Reject 401 return to the token gate without stale action error

tests.name: retry endpoint returns 401
tests.title: Given a FAILED execution, when the retry endpoint returns 401, then the token gate shows "Invalid token" and the admin token field
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution whose retry endpoint rejects the token; when Retry is clicked; then the alert reads 'Invalid token' and the Admin token field is present
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "retry endpoint returns 401" --testTimeout=30000

tests.name: reject endpoint returns 401
tests.title: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when the reject endpoint returns 401, then the token gate shows "Invalid token" and the admin token field
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution whose reject endpoint rejects the token; when Reject is clicked; then the alert reads 'Invalid token' and the Admin token field is present
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "reject endpoint returns 401" --testTimeout=30000

tests.name: clears prior action error
tests.title: Given a prior action error, when a later approve returns 401, then the 401 clears prior action error and no "boom" alert remains after re-entering the token
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution whose first approve returns 500 {error:'boom'} and whose second returns 401; when Approve is clicked twice and the token is entered again; then the Execution region shows no 'boom' alert
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "clears prior action error" --testTimeout=30000

units.title: Verify: No stale round or execution data after a 401 and token re-entry

tests.name: hides execution region
tests.title: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when the approve endpoint returns 401, then it hides execution region and shows the admin token field
tests.scenario: Given an approve action returning 401; When Approve is clicked; Then the Admin token field is shown and queryByRole('region',{name:'Execution'}) is null
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "hides execution region" --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: re-entry reloads data
tests.title: Given a 401 cleared the round and execution, when the admin token is entered again, then re-entry reloads data into the Execution region
tests.scenario: Given the approve action returned 401 and the token gate is shown; When enterToken('secret') is called; Then findByRole('region',{name:'Execution'}) appears and the executions GET count has increased
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "re-entry reloads data" --testTimeout=20000

units.title: REQ · Approve, Retry and Reject 401 clear the token and show the gate with no stale action error
REQ · After a 401 and re-entry, AdminApp shows no stale round or execution data
